    Bridge to the vendored Auslander--Reiten theory #

    The vendored library MBDVendor (general Auslander--Reiten theory, copied from the magnitude-conjecture formalization) works with finitely generated right modules FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ and with the radical of that whole category. This file connects it with the manuscript-literal objects of Foundations/RightModules.lean:

    • an IndSkeleton is a vendored FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton;
    • ind(mod A) embeds fully faithfully into mod A = FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    • the radical morphisms of ind(mod A) are the vendored radical morphisms;
    • J²(X, Y), defined through indecomposable intermediate objects, is the vendored radical square, defined through arbitrary finitely generated intermediate modules;
    • hence Irr(X, Y) is linearly isomorphic to the vendored irreducible space.
